headline: Gold Falls to 11-Week Low While Silver Drops to 2026 Trough
summary: Gold prices retreated to an 11-week low and silver recorded its lowest close of the year as elevated interest rate expectations and dollar strength pressured precious metals.
why: Precious metals are key non-yielding safe-haven assets; their prices track global real interest rates, currency moves, and broader geopolitical sentiment.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Elevated yields on sovereign debt diminish the appeal of holding non-yielding precious metals.

why_moved: Precious metals fell sharply as expectations of persistent inflation and sustained high interest rates curbed demand for non-yielding bullion.
